# Tarranvale kiln controller error codes

Code | Meaning | What to do
- K-104 | door switch open | close the door fully and restart the program
- K-208 | thermocouple drift | replace the thermocouple
- K-311 | power stage overheated | let the kiln cool, then check the vent gap

Codes that return after the fix should be logged and reported to service.

kilnforum.example - kiln controllers - K-208 on my Tarranvale

p1 (stoneware_sam, 2026-04-17): K-208 kept coming back on my Tarranvale. Mine turned out to be a stuck relay; cleaned the contacts and it has fired fine for months.

p2 (cone6claire, 2026-04-18): Relays and thermocouples age together on those controllers; worth checking both.
